main.description: One piece of an athlete's gear: a bike, a pair of shoes, a component, skis. Stored in exactly one place by its visibility: the athlete's repo when Public, else their app.activitytracker.space.athlete tier space for that visibility (followers, mutuals or self). It keeps its rkey when it moves, so its canonical URI is at://{did}/app.activitytracker.gear.item/{rkey} wherever it's stored. The AppView doesn't index it yet.

name.description: The athlete's name for the item, such as Stumpjumper.

type.description: What kind of gear it is. Readers show a value they don't know as other, and keep it when they rewrite the record.

kind.description: What kind of its type it is, from the type's own list (for a bike: road, gravel, mountain, cyclocross, timeTrial, eBike, eMountainBike, fatBike, kids, tandem). Optional. Readers show a value they don't know as the type alone, and keep it.

sports.description: The sports the item is for, as app.activitytracker.feed.activity sport values.

photo.description: Its blob is stored where the record is: in the repo when Public, else in the same tier space.

retiredAt.description: When the athlete retired it. Absent: in use.
